title: AARO Solved Iraq's 'Jellyfish' as Balloons. Alaska's Jellyfish UFO Still Lacks the Data

title: Jellyfish UFO In Rainbow Over Alaskan Military Base Busted By UFOlogists; It’s Not What You Think It Is

title: Alaska Jellyfish UFO Mystery Takes Bizarre Turn as Experts Reveal What Was Spotted Near US Military Base
